note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Protect the operator's machine from Arcadia's scripts and tests
purpose: Arcadia's own scripts and tests should not be able to damage the operator's machine. Shell scripts should fail safely, tests should stay away from the live workspace, and unsaved or local-only working copies should raise an alert.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia running work on the operator's behalf without putting the operator's own data at risk.
done_when: A checked-in script that could delete through an empty variable fails the lint check, the test suite refuses the live workspace, and unsaved working copies raise one alert a day until they are pushed or retired.
reading_note: Draft: none of the 5 Actions has started.

actions.title: Stop shell scripts from deleting through an empty variable
actions.why: A script that removes a path built from an empty variable can wipe far more than was intended.
actions.done_when: A check fails any tracked script that lacks fail-fast settings or deletes through an unguarded variable, and the check passes on the base branch.

actions.title: Keep the test suite away from the live workspace
actions.why: Tests that reach the operator's real workspace or configuration could change real data.
actions.done_when: Tests cannot resolve the live workspace or the operator's configuration, and a command without an inline workspace fails instead of using the live one.

actions.title: Alert the operator about unsaved work
actions.why: Work that exists only on one disk is easy to lose, and nobody sees it unless told.
actions.done_when: Working copies that stay unsaved or local-only past a set threshold produce one alert, at most once a day each, which clears when the copy is pushed or retired.

actions.title: Sort unsaved working copies by outcome
actions.why: Shows which copies have already shipped, which are superseded and which hold the only copy of some work.
actions.done_when: A read-only command gives every unsaved or local-only copy exactly one outcome, backed by evidence.

actions.title: Preserve unique work as draft pull requests
actions.why: Moves work that exists only on this machine onto GitHub without cleaning or resetting anything.
actions.done_when: Unique work from one named copy is preserved as a draft pull request only when the command is run for that copy, and every apply refuses until the repository has a secret-scan and generated-file policy.
